title: Docker: templates, store + install panel
question: Store plus install form: panel or full page? (Click an app)

variants.label: Store + side panel
variants.notes: The app store grid from A. Clicking an app opens the install panel from B on the right, the grid stays visible next to it. Close it with the X. Shown with Vaultwarden open; clicking any card opens it.

variants.label: Store + app page
variants.notes: The app store grid from A. Clicking an app opens a full app page with what it needs, the install form and more about the app. The arrow goes back to all apps. Shown with Vaultwarden open; clicking any card opens it.
